text: Queso para freír is a firm, salty fresh white pressed cheese from the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico that softens but keeps its shape when fried, turning crisp and golden outside and soft inside.

links.name: Tropical Cheese, Queso de Freír product page

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The curds are pressed to take out moisture.
The curd is shaped into blocks.
The cheese is lightly salted and aged only briefly, so it stays firm enough to fry without melting.
